title: REINVENT4 Generative Lead Design
description: Reinforcement-learning based molecular generation using REINVENT4. Supports de novo design, scaffold decoration, linker design, and scaffold hopping.

seed_smiles.description: Seed scaffold SMILES for scaffold_decoration, linker_design, and scaffold_hopping modes. Coumarin (default) is a common drug scaffold.
seed_smiles.help_text: Provide a chemically valid SMILES string of the core scaffold to decorate or hop from.

mode.description: Generation mode. scaffold_decoration adds substituents to a fixed core; de_novo generates freely; linker_design connects two fragments; scaffold_hopping replaces the core scaffold.
mode.help_text: de_novo requires no seed. scaffold_hopping uses mol2mol prior and bioisostere replacement.

scoring_function.description: Reward function for RL training. qed_sa optimises drug-likeness + synthetic accessibility; docking_gnina uses AutoDock-GNINA docking score (requires receptor); custom_toml uses user-supplied TOML.

receptor.description: Receptor PDB file. Required when scoring_function=docking_gnina.

custom_toml.description: Custom REINVENT TOML configuration. Required when scoring_function=custom_toml.

n_steps.description: RL training epochs. 500 = ~15 min on GPU; 200 = quick demo run.

batch_size.description: Molecules sampled per epoch. Larger batches improve diversity but increase memory.

top_n.description: Number of top-scoring molecules to include in final SDF output.

min_qed.description: Minimum QED (drug-likeness) score for output molecules. QED > 0.6 is drug-like.

max_sa_score.description: Maximum synthetic accessibility score. SA < 3 = easy, > 6 = difficult.

min_tanimoto_novelty.description: Minimum Tanimoto distance from seed to ensure novelty of generated molecules.

pains_filter.description: Remove PAINS (pan-assay interference compounds) from output. Recommended for hit-to-lead.

gpu.description: Enable GPU-accelerated RL training. Strongly recommended for n_steps > 200.

n_cpus.description: CPU cores for scoring and filtering steps.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
